name: The same marks on Cyrillic text
description: The same lines over Cyrillic text. The rule that decides if a mark is allowed looks at the type of the neighbouring character, and Cyrillic letters go through a different code path than Latin ones.
descriptionHtml:
The same lines over Cyrillic text. The rule that decides if a mark is allowed looks at the type of the neighbouring character, and Cyrillic letters go through a different code path than Latin ones.

Manual run: 📋 Copy application.Samples.Form.RichTextOnFormTest#markCombinationsOverCyrillic into GitHub Actions → Run Workflow → include PATH
